meta.title: Nove Records — your health, organized. Ask anything.
meta.description: Labs, prescriptions, doctor notes, and wearable data in one timeline. An AI agent that answers questions about your health, grounded in your own data.

hero.headline: Your health, organized. Ask anything.
hero.subheadline: Records pulls labs, prescriptions, doctor notes, and wearable data into a single timeline. The AI agent answers questions about your health using your own history — not internet generalities.

items.title: All your health, in one place
items.description: Labs, prescriptions, vaccinations, visits, and wearables in one chronological timeline. Upload a PDF, forward an email, or sync — Records does the rest.

items.title: An AI agent that knows your data
items.description: Ask 'why is my LDL elevated?' or 'what's changed since last year?' The agent answers in plain language, grounded in your own records.

items.title: Trends across years
items.description: Biomarkers, blood pressure, weight, sleep, training load — all on the same chart. Spot drift early, not at the next checkup.

items.title: Built to share with your doctor
items.description: Generate a clean, structured summary in seconds. Hand it to your physician and skip the 'fill out this form' ritual.

socialProof.headline: The future of health is continuous

testimonials.quote: Continuous data from wearable sensors provides a rich, granular, high-definition view of each person's health — and that changes everything.
testimonials.name: Dr. Eric Topol
testimonials.role: Cardiologist, founder of Scripps Research Translational Institute

testimonials.quote: The opportunity with sensors, data, and AI is to move us from being intermittent and reactive to being continuous and proactive.
testimonials.name: Dr. Daniel Kraft
testimonials.role: Founder of NextMed Health, faculty chair for Medicine at Singularity University

testimonials.quote: P4 medicine — predictive, preventive, personalized, participatory — is proactive instead of reactive. It's about wellness, not just disease.
testimonials.name: Dr. Leroy Hood
testimonials.role: Co-founder of the Institute for Systems Biology, pioneer of systems medicine
